title: ui_follow
summary: MSUI now carries current Benilla's client-only auto-follow: UnitPopup's exact-name row and /follow, /fol, /f target/name forms converge on the ordered player/assist/dead/stunned/casting gate; the mode re-resolves every tick, steers at pi rad/s, synthesizes ordinary forward input, uses the exact speed-scaled 3/4.5-yard hysteresis, and ends on manual movement start, mouse-look, lost mover, root/taxi, target loss/death or vertical degeneracy. Begin/End produce the latched-name centered GameFontNormalHuge status, with End fading linearly for four seconds. No dedicated packet exists or was added.

openItems.text: No follow intent path (unit-popup Follow row / slash command) and no follow movement mode to bridge.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: UnitPopup Follow plus /follow, /fol and /f resolve live player subjects into AutoFollowUiLaw; GameLoop synthesizes the normal forward axis and bounded facing while the ordinary controller and movement sender retain ownership.

openItems.text: No AUTOFOLLOW_BEGIN/END equivalent events or on-screen status text with the reference's latched-name and 4-second linear fade semantics.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Begin and End state now latch the subject name and draw the exact centered 20px gold status on BACKGROUND; active is full alpha and stop fades linearly over four seconds before hiding.

openItems.text: Focused gate, threshold, steering, fade, source-order and no-wire checks pass. Needs a live friendly-player run covering far approach, 3/4.5-yard hysteresis, W/S/A/D/Q/E and right-mouse cancellation, jump survival, target death/despawn, refusal ordering, and the centered Begin/End line at multiple UI scales.
